title: Savion Castro
description: Promotes hiring teachers based on race.
body:
# Savion Castro

# Board of Education Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/castro.png)

- Promotes **[hiring teachers](https://www.savioncastro.com/issues.html)** based on race.
- Puts **[a focus](https://www.savioncastro.com/issues.html)** on students based on race. Castro said,” We must embrace restorative justice as a way of life and concept to heal the injustices in our education system perpetrated on Black and Brown children.”
- Castro also **[gives priorities](https://www.savioncastro.com/issues.html)** to parents based on their race, “I recommend forming a citizen task force to provide recommendations on how we improve transparency and engagement with community members, especially Black and Brown parents.”
- **[Supported](https://madison365.com/with-new-board-president-and-vp-madison-school-leadership-team-is-now-all-black/?fbclid=IwAR06y8z7KFhuUvJdy08NsDipRUAx3ZQXvCuWK41NzenO2mmKplvpuW5sGDs)** getting rid of school resource officers (police) in schools.
